address: Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental Hotel, West Corniche Road, Al Ras Al Akhdar, Abu Dhabi
bio: This modern, American brasserie located in the Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental hotel is perfect for a lively evening in a Broadway-inspired setting. Combined with a DJ, live music on Saturday night, sharp service by a well-drilled team and a concise menu delivering a roll call of classics, you’ve got the ingredients for a glamourous night out with friends. The experienced chef delivers comforting dishes such as omelette Arnold Bennett, lobster bisque and their signature beef Wellington to share. Don’t miss steaks cooked to perfection and the glorious tart Tatin. They also offer a brunch on Saturday and a traditional roast on Sunday.
